lines.text: At Shiloh, the Levite heads asked Eleazar, Joshua and the tribal heads for cities, as the LORD commanded through Moses.
The first lot came out for the Kohathite clans, and Aaron's descendants received thirteen cities from Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.
Aaron's descendants received Hebron, but its fields and villages had already been given to Joshua son of Nun.
The Levites received twelve cities in all, and each city had its own surrounding pasturelands.
The LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to their fathers, and they settled in it.
